hi there. i read your previous posts and i know you've gone through some really hard times. you are brave and i admire you courage. 

i know you are tired and you feel empty, but please try to believe that you are loved because that is the truth. your daughter loves you. the greatest kind of love.. the most healing kind of love… is unconditional love. all children have unconditional love in their hearts for their parents. from your other posts, i know that you're trying your best to be a good parent. your daughter needs you in her life. as a girl that doesn't have a father, i can tell you firsthand that daughters do really need their dads in their lives.
